title: Root-line transport for normalized unit and tensor inverse image
statement: Fix l prime, E/Q_l finite, f:X→Y, Base b, Geometry g, and its normalized CoefficientPullback q and TensorPullback k [def-sfb-tower-class-tensor-pullback, def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Suppose l is a unit in Γ(Y,O_Y). For normalized Chern data cY,cX [def-sp-tower-class-chern], LinePullback(f,g,cY,cX) [def-sp-tower-class-pullback] is nonempty. Its adjoint is exactly coefficient restriction tensored with restrictRoot on every finite pure tensor. No twisting equivalence, positive functor comparison, or projection map is asserted.

proof.text: Apply finiteLineComparisons_exists to obtain the finite isomorphisms and their actual coefficient/root tensor formula. This theorem pulls the global unit to X and both sets of residue fields and specializes the existing finite Tate comparison theorem.

Conjugate those comparisons by ordinaryPullEvaluation and the two lineEvaluation isomorphisms. The normalized finite tensor formulas imply horizontal compatibility by lem-sfb-tower-class-line-pullback-horizontal. Apply systemIsoOfEvaluation_exists to obtain an ordinary system isomorphism whose evaluations are exactly those conjugates.

Evaluate the ordinary adjoint using the tower unit evaluation theorem and naturality of ordinaryPushEvaluation. Its evaluation equals the finite adjoint of inverse ordinaryPullEvaluation followed by the evaluated system map. Substitute the assembly equations, cancel the comparison isomorphisms, and use naturality of the finite Hom equivalence in source and target. Applying the resulting morphism equality to the inverse lineEvaluation of a finite tensor cancels the source lineEvaluation and gives the finite tensor formula. This is precisely LinePullback.normalization.
